propositions: A declarative metric registry must map each metric id to its lens, data source, compute function, confidence level, and source classification.
Metrics with no available data must return an Unavailable state containing a non-empty reason and an ISO-formatted accruing_since timestamp.
The is_authoritative helper must segregate backfill_classified and classified values, excluding them from authoritative aggregations that contain only structural, git, sidecar, or snapshot sources.
Every REGISTRY entry must have a unique id, a lens, a source, and a confidence — validated by unit test assertion that the count of unique ids equals the total entry count.

The source label must support values in {structural, git, sidecar, snapshot, backfill_classified} and confidence must support values in {high, classified}, riding on every metric value for downstream filtering.
